title: An Approach to Ensure Fairness in News Articles

bias_targets.methodology: Binary classification of biased versus unbiased news sentences using fine-tuned DistilBERT, and extraction of bias-bearing words using a RoBERTa-based Named Entity Recognition (NER) pipeline on the MBIC dataset.
